about_the_game:
Welcome to “First Pregnancy: Matsumoto–Daihoku Area Edition”!

This serious game (an educational game designed to address social issues) lets players learn about daily life during pregnancy and the local support systems available. You play as the main character who has just learned she’s pregnant and experience her journey while interacting with her partner, medical professionals, and family.

Based on information from the Matsumoto–Daihoku region in Nagano Prefecture, the game naturally introduces local medical systems and support programs. Enjoy the story while deepening your understanding of pregnancy and childbirth.

⸻

Game Features

• Experience Pregnancy Through an Interactive Story

Play as a woman in early pregnancy and go through daily events such as managing physical changes, attending prenatal checkups, joining parenting classes, and preparing for childbirth. Medical and administrative knowledge is woven naturally into the story.

• Branching Choices That Influence the Story

The narrative changes depending on your choices in conversations and actions. Each option is accompanied by explanations so that players can learn the appropriate responses through gameplay.

• Realistic Settings Based on Local Information

Local resources from Matsumoto, Omachi, and Azumino cities are featured, including maternal and child health handbooks, medical expense subsidies, hometown deliveries, and postpartum care.

⸻

Highlights

• Approx. 1-hour playtime with save/load functions

• Suitable not only for pregnant individuals but also for healthcare students, educators, high school students, and those considering pregnancy

• Learn about the social systems that support pregnancy and childbirth in an engaging way

⸻

Development Background

This game was developed with support from the Nagano Prefectural “Regional Vitality Promotion Fund.”

It was planned and supervised by a pediatrician from the Department of Pediatrics, Shinshu University School of Medicine, with contributions from medical students and childcare support volunteers.

It is widely used as an educational tool to help people understand the real-life flow of medical and welfare services.

⸻

Recommended For

• Pregnant individuals

• Students and young people interested in pregnancy and childbirth

• Educators and professionals in childcare and welfare

• Those with pregnant partners or family members

• Anyone interested in learning about local support systems

⸻

Development Team

• Developer: M-Terrace

• Supervision: Matsumoto–Daihoku Regional Birth and Childcare Safety Network Council

• Planning: Department of Pediatrics, Shinshu University School of Medicine (Dr. Yukihide Miyosawa)

⸻

Medical Disclaimer

This game is intended for educational and awareness purposes only. It does not substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. If you are experiencing health concerns or unusual symptoms, please consult a physician or midwife.

⸻

Begin your journey through pregnancy in the beautiful natural surroundings and warm support of Shinshu.

Deepen your understanding of pregnancy and childbirth with “First Pregnancy: Matsumoto–Ōhoku Area Edition.”

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows11, windows10
  • Processor: 2Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX Compatible video card with Pixel Shader 3.0 and Vertex Shader 3.0 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound
